response.sql: WITH total_items AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM Order_Items), product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_item_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(t.item_count, 0) AS item_share FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id CROSS JOIN total_items t GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description, t.item_count), type_stats AS (SELECT product_type_description, AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM product_stats GROUP BY product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity, AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM type_stats

assumptions.assumption: Nonempty product_quantity values contain numeric text; empty strings and NULLs are missing values.
